paired_evaluation_wavs.scope: Source audit, mix and reverberation construction, PCM WAV writes, checkpoint and coverage publication.
paired_evaluation_wavs.parity: PCM WAV bytes, diagnostics, manifest rows and coverage agree. The candidate resumed after 448 verified WAVs from the baseline.

cuda_features.scope: Actual augmentation through CUDA embedding, feature writes and verification.
cuda_features.parity: Feature array and augmentation journal SHA-256, metadata and resumed results agree.

recommendation.scope: Bound inputs, complete grid evaluation, durable per-comparison journal and published artifacts.
recommendation.parity: All comparison records, search, recommendation and receipt bytes agree at fixed publication times.

evaluation_summary.scope: Read the persisted clip report, summarize the candidates and publish a report.
evaluation_summary.parity: The report SHA-256 agrees with the completed report.

evaluation_coverage.parity: The coverage record SHA-256 agrees with the completed coverage record.

continuous_negative_streams.scope: Read and hash source intervals from bound completed evidence, render WAVs, validate saved PCM and write receipts.
continuous_negative_streams.parity: WAV and original PCM SHA-256, interval order and lineage agree with the completed output.

tts_quality_and_wav_storage.scope: Technical checks, PCM conversion, WAV serialization and file SHA-256.
tts_quality_and_wav_storage.parity: Every technical result and WAV byte agrees.

reference_preparation.scope: Reference trimming, preparation, waveform storage and receipt validation.
reference_preparation.parity: PCM, settings, trim plan and inspected WAV structure agree. New PCM-float file creation timestamps are normalized for the comparison.

single_thread_export_verifier.scope: Warm CPU export and model format check for all trained heads. The existing shipping export implementation was used.

scope: Each measurement covers the stated stage. Disk contention varies across runs. These measurements cover completed public-source and synthetic test evidence plus the recorded training artifacts.
compatibility: Release digest aliases bind the qualified source bytes to the previous output contract. Revalidate both installation layouts and the source checkout line endings.
